about_the_game:
• Armoured car “Death Machine”
  • Weapon: Grenadier drone — 2 pcs., AD-12 Falcon
  • “Death” structural parts
  • Unique epic cabin “The call”
  • A unique portrait of Daniel Reyes aka Death
  • 1500 in-game coins

Additionally, the player gets:
  • Unique decor "Twin exhaust", 2 pcs.
  • Exclusive sticker “Pale horse”
  • Spray can with unique paint “Epitaph”
  • “Shiv (ST)”, 6 pcs.
  • “Chameleon”
  • Rare generator “Big G”
  • Increases the maximum number of parts used to 55

Daniel Reyes was an industrial spy who made his way to the test site to steal blueprints of drones. But in the end, he was locked up with dozens of Waderkvarn employees. Some of them went crazy with crossout and seized the inside bunker. Cruel laws reigned within.
Then Reyes entered the picture. He feigned resignation and with all his strength made his way to the top of the food chain. He coldly sacrificed people to reach his goal — to overthrow the invaders and escape from Waderkvarn. The goal was everything to him. And worth it all.
Together with the other Horsemen, they formed an underground resistance. For a long time, Death manipulated one of the invaders, pushed for the abuse of new abilities, so that one day his body would give up. And when the resistance was strong enough, the system cracked as if by itself.
How in conditions of isolation and lack of resources, did Reyes manage to understand so well the effect of the virus on the body? Most likely, he had help. After that, he no longer tried to hide from Waderkvarn.
All members of the gang unconditionally believe and follow Death. Well, as for Death... Death has a plan.


The unique armoured cars presented in packs are known for their particular balance of weapons, armour and speed characteristics in combat. To put the car in the garage, after starting the game, open the blueprint menu («B» key ), go to the “Packs” tab, select the desired armoured car and press the “Assemble” button.

When you purchase this pack, the number of parts that can be used to build a vehicle increases to 55.

Buying the pack also gives early access to some factional structural parts. These parts become available immediately upon purchase and are not handed out again upon reaching the appropriate reputation level. Some parts are one-of-a-kind, and players can only own one copy of such parts. When simultaneously buying a standard and deluxe pack the constructional parts and portraits are not duplicated

Unique portraits are an excellent opportunity to stand out among survivors.

Paint cans are a way to make your armoured car unlike the others.

Coins — is the in-game currency, which is used on the market to purchase armoured car parts from other survivors and to pay for the rent of part-building workbenches. Attention! When buying multiple packs, the acquired coins stack!
